description: FOUR NATIVE FRAMES of ONE Rune Sentinel BASE outfit. NORTH=top-left, EAST=top-right, SOUTH=bottom-left, WEST=bottom-right, each cell64x64 with32px human. SOUTH IS CANONICAL AND FROZEN. Redraw other costumes to be the SAME outfit. Copy south's metal construction and dark undergarment: fitted steel helmet/brow/side panels, solid beveled chest/back plates, belt, two short hip plates, small shoulder caps, fitted bracers, paired knee caps, FULL broad greaves and matching steel boots. North/west look too much like puffy Citizen clothes: replace white fabric texture with deliberate STEEL PLATES and CHARCOAL CLOTH sleeves/upper thighs/joints (#202020 cloth against #C0C0C0 steel). No speckled scratches/checkerboard. All plates have corresponding paired coverage and ends, not white wires. EAST: remove huge circular plate on NEAR UPPER ARM. This long arm ends at LOWER HAND. Give it a small shoulder cap, dark upper sleeve, short bracer near the hand; narrow foreshortened CHEST PLATE lies to the RIGHT of this arm. No shield/chest gem on arm. NORTH: back of helmet/backplate, no new face or front chest rune. WEST: LEFT-facing original occluded face. EAST: RIGHT-facing original raised-hand gesture. Single DIAMOND RUNESTONE stays on FRONT of chest, only foreshortened if visible in profile. Preserve exact native anatomy, limb bends, all hand/face/foot positions, silhouette and opacity. Masked pixels stay opaque. No poses, rescaling or added limbs. Crisp native pixel clusters, fixed upper-left light. Perspective changes shading/occlusion, not garment identity. Neutral grayscale costume only, real skin untouched. No crest/spikes/addons, cape, flag, weapon, particles or text.
reason: The independent first-pass north/west looked too much like white Citizen clothing; east copied an oversized circular upper-arm plate. Present all views together with south frozen to improve garment identity and anatomy-specific placement.
